# The Environment: what is round a scene

What is round the scene a note is shown in, a list of elements on its Environment card. The plan and its status are [next/environment.md](../next/environment.md).

## The card

EnvironmentCard - the Environment: what is round the scene a note is shown in, as a list (next/environment.md; `Surroundings`). Each element is a row of the card's list (`EnvironmentSection`, drawn as the Props card draws props, `PropsCard`): the light, shafts of light, what drifts in the air, what is heard - each with its properties, Roll for another of it, Keep, Remove, and Used to set it aside. "+ Add to the environment" opens the Dex on what can be round a scene. Below them, a row for each thing on the Props card that throws light or makes a sound of its own (`PropSection.lit`, `PropSection.heard`), its share tuned.

Its block in a document is `environment:` (`Surroundings.KNOBS`). It hands the reading its part of the document a medium is drawn from (`ReadingPanel.document_parts`: `environment`), and the sound it chose as the bed under the voice where no other card hands one, or where the one handed has no place of its own (`ReadingPanel.bed`, `ReadingBed.under`). Changed while the note plays, the playing scene takes it at once (the live document's `environment`). A scene that hosts no environment reads none of it.

Where a component's show makes what is round the scene (`ReadingPanel.environment`: a table show's episode at its table, `EpisodeEnvironment`), the list is that show's, in place of the note's own.

Each element that is heard has a Test: it alone, at the level it has under the voice, following what is changed on it until pressed again (`test`, `SoundTest`).

Source: [src/table/environment_card.gd](../src/table/environment_card.gd)

## What can be round a scene

Surroundings - what is round a scene (next/environment.md; `EnvironmentCard`): a list of elements, each a kind of thing (`KINDS`) - the light the scene is in, shafts of light through its haze, something drifting in its air, something heard round it, fog lying low or filling the air - with a number of its own and the properties a person set on it. A property never set is drawn from the element's number inside its field's bounds (`Roll`), so a new number is another variant of the same thing. The Dex offers every kind, each light preset and a few looks of shafts, beams and fog (`offers`), and what a person keeps (`EnvironmentLibrary`).

The note's `environment:` block: `elements` (each `{kind, seed, name, off, own, <its fields>}` - `name` where it was kept under one, `off` while it is set aside, `own` the words of the host it came from, a table's `TableSurroundings`), `lights` (how strongly each thing in the scene that throws light throws it, by the name its scene gives it: a share) and `heard` (how loud each thing that makes a sound of its own is). `sanitize` makes it safe; a host reads it through `light_of`, `brightness`, `rays`, `effects_of`, `sound_of` and `fog_for`. A scene with no element of a kind keeps its own (its own light, its own shaft, no air, silence).

Every light preset is a row of numbers each host reads as it can: a desk its lamp, candles and the room's light through a window (`DeskLook`); the Dispatch desk its hollow's ambient, the shaft that falls through its ceiling and its lamp (`DispatchMedium`). A row with no `weight` is only ever chosen: a desk drawing its own light from its number never draws it.

Source: [src/table/surroundings.gd](../src/table/surroundings.gd)

### Kinds (20)

Each kind of element (`Surroundings.KINDS`): the Dex's shelf it stands on, and whether a scene has at most one.

| Kind | Shelf | One | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `light` Light | `light` | yes | The light the scene is in - lamplight, candlelight, daylight, dusk, moonlight or none - and how bright. |
| `shafts` Light shafts | `light` |  | Shafts of light through the haze - through a window, a crack, the leaves: each a column as wide as the gap it came through, landing in a bright patch its own size. |
| `beams` Colored beams | `light` |  | Beams of colored light from fixtures hung high over the scene, as a stage's or a club's: some hold still and some sweep, each keeps a color a while and moves on to another, some strobe. |
| `haze` Haze | `air` |  | A bank of haze far off, out of focus behind the work: the room's depth, and what light shafts fall through. |
| `fog` Fog | `air` |  | Fog through the scene - lying low on the ground or filling the air, one even sheet or patches with clear air between, still, carried on a wind or swaying to and fro. |
| `dust` Dust | `air` |  | Motes of dust drifting through the light, barely there. |
| `pixies` Pixies | `air` |  | Tiny bright points of colored light that dart and drift, alone or in twos and threes: magic in the air. |
| `fireflies` Fireflies | `air` |  | Slow, low sparks that blink on for a moment and off for longer. |
| `wisps` Wisps | `air` |  | Large, faint, slow glows that hang and drift in the distance. |
| `embers` Embers | `air` |  | Sparks rising from somewhere below, flickering, winking out. |
| `snow` Snow | `air` |  | Flakes falling slowly, drifting as they fall - snow, ash, pollen. |
| `rain` Rain | `sound` | yes | Rain falling outside, or on what is over the scene. |
| `wind` Wind | `sound` | yes | A wind outside, moaning round the eaves in a gust. |
| `fire` Fire | `sound` | yes | A fire burning nearby, crackling - a hearth, a stove. |
| `insects` Insects | `sound` | yes | Crickets in the grass, chirp after chirp, or cicadas swelling in the trees. |
| `stream` Stream | `sound` | yes | Running water - a brook, a fountain, a gutter after rain. |
| `sea` Sea | `sound` | yes | Waves on a shore some way off, against a hull, round a dock. |
| `creature` A creature | `sound` |  | An animal heard and never seen, made of numbers rather than a kind: how big, how breathy, the calls it makes, how many and how lively. |
| `ride` The ride | `sound` | yes | What the scene is aboard, heard - a train's rumble and its wheels knocking, a cart jolting: heard only where the scene moves. |
| `flies` Flies | `air` |  | Dark specks that zip about in zig-zags, hover a moment and fly off - flies, gnats. |

### Light presets (6)

Each preset (`Surroundings.LIGHTS`) a light element chooses: how often a desk's number draws it (0: only ever chosen), and what it is. The Dex offers each as an element of its own.

| Light | Drawn | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lamplight` Lamplight | 4 | Night: a lamp lights the work, the room dark round it - a screen's glow, a street lamp, a fire, the moon in a window. |
| `candlelight` Candlelight | 2.5 | Night with the lamp off: candles light the work, their shadows moving with their flames. |
| `daylight` Daylight | 2 | Day: the sun falls through a window across the work, the bars' shadows over it, the sky filling the room. |
| `dusk` Dusk | 1.5 | Evening: a low gold sun through the window, long shadows, and the lamp on. |
| `moonlight` Moonlight | 0 | Night with every lamp off: the moon through a window, white and cold, bright enough to see by. |
| `darkness` No light | 0 | Nearly dark: no lamp, no candle, only the faint light of the room - the work's own glow, if it has any. |

## What each can be told

A property set stays; one left unset is drawn from the element's own number inside the bounds it is rolled in (`Roll`), so Roll gives another of the same thing.

### A light (`LIGHT_FIELDS`)

| Property | What it is | Type | Bounds | Rolled in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` Light | The light the scene is in; its own, as the scene lights itself. | `enum` | `own`, `lamplight`, `candlelight`, `daylight`, `dusk`, `moonlight`, `darkness` | `lamplight`, `candlelight`, `daylight`, `dusk`, `moonlight` |
| `brightness` Brightness | How bright the whole scene is, over its light's own: 1 as the light is. | `float` | 0.25 to 2.5 | 0.85 to 1.25 |
| `lamp` Lamp | Whether the lamp at the work is on: as the light has it (moonlight, daylight and candlelight put it out), or switched on or off whatever the light. | `enum` | `light`, `on`, `off` | never: its default until set |

### Light shafts (`SHAFT_FIELDS`)

| Property | What it is | Type | Bounds | Rolled in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` Beams | How many beams fall. | `int` | 1 to 30 | 3 to 14 |
| `width` Width | How wide each beam is, from a pencil's width to a window's. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.1 to 0.55 |
| `inner` Inner shafts | How many narrower shafts fall inside each beam, twice as bright where they cross it. | `int` | 0 to 3 | 0 to 2 |
| `turn` Direction | Which way they come from, turned round from the scene's own light (degrees). | `float` | -180 to 180 | -60 to 60 |
| `steep` Steepness | How steeply they fall, over the scene's own light: below 0 lower, as a sun near setting (degrees). | `float` | -40 to 30 | -20 to 12 |
| `spread` Spread | How far each beam's way strays from the others' (degrees): 0 all parallel, as through one window; more, as through leaves. | `float` | 0 to 25 | 0 to 9 |
| `strength` Strength | How strongly they light the haze, and the patches where they land. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.3 to 0.7 |
| `variety` Variety | How the beams' widths stray from the Width: 0 all alike; above 0 some much fatter, below 0 some much skinnier; and how much they differ in brightness. | `float` | -1 to 1 | -0.6 to 0.6 |
| `flicker` Flicker | How much they shimmer, as light through moving leaves does. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0 to 0.3 |
| `color` Color | Their color; unset, the light's own. | `color` |  | never: its default until set |

### Colored beams (`BEAM_FIELDS`)

Its Colors' choices are the beams' palettes (`StageBeams.PALETTES`).

| Property | What it is | Type | Bounds | Rolled in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` Beams | How many beams there are. | `int` | 1 to 24 | 5 to 14 |
| `width` Width | How wide each beam is at its lens, from a laser's to a floodlight's. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.15 to 0.5 |
| `spread` Spread | How much each beam opens as it goes (degrees): 0 a column, more a cone. | `float` | 0 to 15 | 1.5 to 7 |
| `palette` Colors | The colors the beams draw from. | `enum` | `club`, `rainbow`, `warm`, `cool`, `ice`, `one` | `club`, `rainbow`, `warm`, `cool` |
| `color` Color | One color for every beam; unset, the palette's. | `color` |  | never: its default until set |
| `moving` Moving | How many of the beams sweep: 0 all hold still, 1 all move. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.35 to 0.85 |
| `sweep` Sweep | How far a moving beam swings (degrees). | `float` | 0 to 70 | 14 to 45 |
| `speed` Speed | How fast the moving beams swing: a slow sway to a quick sweep. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.2 to 0.6 |
| `hold` Hold | How long a beam keeps a color before it changes (seconds). | `float` | 0.2 to 20 | 1.2 to 5 |
| `variety` Variety | How much the beams' holds differ: 0 all change together; 1 some keep theirs four times as long, some change four times as often. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.3 to 0.9 |
| `blend` Blend | How a color gives way to the next: 0 at once, 1 eased over the whole hold. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0 to 0.4 |
| `strobe` Strobe | How many of the beams strobe, in bursts. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0 to 0.3 |
| `rate` Strobe rate | How many times a second a strobing beam flashes. | `float` | 1 to 15 | 3 to 8 |
| `strength` Strength | How strongly they light the haze, and the patches where they land. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.45 to 0.8 |
| `turn` Direction | Where round the scene their fixtures hang, turned from where its own light comes from (degrees). | `float` | -180 to 180 | -40 to 40 |

### Fog (`FOG_FIELDS`)

Its Activation's choices are the fog's curves (`Effects.FOG_SHAPES`).

| Property | What it is | Type | Bounds | Rolled in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `density` Density | How thick it is: a whisper of mist to fog nothing is seen through. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.35 to 0.7 |
| `height` Height | How high it reaches above the ground (cm). | `float` | 5 to 300 | 20 to 90 |
| `settle` Low lying | How it lies: 0 as thick at its top as on the ground, filling all it reaches; 1 thick on the ground and thinning fast above it. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.55 to 0.95 |
| `patches` Patches | 0 one even sheet; toward 1 patches of fog with clear air between them. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0 to 0.6 |
| `patch` Patch size | How big each patch is (m). | `float` | 0.2 to 8 | 0.8 to 3 |
| `grain` Swirls | How big its swirls and billows are (cm). | `float` | 3 to 200 | 15 to 60 |
| `activation` Activation | The curve that turns its swirls into fog and clear air: smooth, billows with gaps, thin wisps, sharp-edged clumps, or folds like poured smoke. | `enum` |  | `smooth`, `billows`, `wisps` |
| `chaos` Chaos | How irregular it all is: 0 even - its sway and gusts regular, its swirls as drawn; 1 wild - swings and gusts of every length, swirls folded into themselves, thick and thin from place to place. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.1 to 0.45 |
| `rolls` Rolls | How much it rolls and turns over as it goes. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.15 to 0.6 |
| `wind` Wind | How fast a wind carries it: 0 still air, 1 a stiff breeze. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.05 to 0.35 |
| `turn` Wind direction | Which way it blows (degrees): 0 left to right as the scene is first seen, 90 toward the viewer, -90 away, 180 right to left. | `float` | -180 to 180 | -60 to 60 |
| `gusts` Gusts | How much the wind comes and goes: 0 steady; 1 from a lull to gusts twice as strong. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.1 to 0.5 |
| `stretch` Streaks | How far its swirls are drawn out along the wind: 0 round, 1 long streaks. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0.1 to 0.6 |
| `sway` Sway | How far it swings back and forth along the wind's way, in slow waves passing through it. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0 to 0.4 |
| `pace` Sway pace | How long one swing takes (seconds); it breathes a little slower. | `float` | 2 to 60 | 9 to 22 |
| `breathe` Breathe | How much it rises and sinks, thinning as it rises and thickening as it sinks. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0 to 0.35 |
| `glow` Glow | Light of its own, so it shows where no light falls on it. | `float` | 0 to 1 | 0 to 0.2 |
| `color` Color | Its color; unset, the light's fog. | `color` |  | never: its default until set |

| `size` Size | How big each is (mm). | `float` |  | never: its default until set |
| `glow` Glow | How brightly each glows. | `float` | 0 to 1 | never: its default until set |
| `speed` Speed | How fast they wander. | `float` | 0 to 1 | never: its default until set |
| `color` Color | Their color. | `color` |  | never: its default until set |
